name: Bysmillah
tagline: Interest-free car financing — a halal peer-to-peer car marketplace for California
role: Full-stack engineering — public site, product app, staff console and API

scenes.title: Finance a car without interest
scenes.body: Buyers and sellers agree a fixed, fully disclosed price — paid in installments, never riba.

scenes.title: Two halal ways to finance
scenes.body: Murabaha: true cost plus a fixed, disclosed markup. Musawama: a fair price agreed between buyer and seller.

scenes.title: Every deal guided by a person
scenes.body: Contact the team, get matched with a buyer or seller, then sign a contract drafted for California law.

scenes.title: Apply as a buyer or a seller
scenes.body: Sellers can paste a VIN to auto-fill the car's year, make and model.

scenes.title: A free vehicle check by VIN
scenes.body: Specs, recalls for that model, crash-test ratings and fuel costs from NHTSA and EPA data — no sign-up.

scenes.title: AI assistants, overseen by people
scenes.body: A Telegram Q&A advisor is in development; contract and payment assistants are planned.
